items.text:
Honestly, I wish I could recommend this game. I loved his last work - but that's not really what we're discussing, here.

This is probably about the most bare-bones a game could ever possibly get for being considered a game. There's just... Really, honestly, nothing here. If you've made it past the character generator, and into the game itself, you've realistically seen just about everything the game has to offer. There's not really a story, not really any characters, not really much of... Anything, really. You'll probably work to get your first EVA suit, realize that eliminates about half the work and pre-planning required of any run in this game, and then call it quits from there. As you can see from my having a paltry 5 hours in the game, it's about what I did. 

With the development cycle being as absolutely glacial as it is, I just can't recommend it. This was "released," in 2020, and we're just getting the ability to be able to label our containers in-game. Let that sink in: in a game nearly purely about salvaging wrecks of interstellar vessels, it's taken over 5 years for the dev to create a labeling system. IDK, I wish him the best. I don't regret tossing money at the project, but know that you're essentially paying now for a game to maybe play in about 10 years time.
items.text_zh:
说实话，我真希望能推荐这款游戏。我很喜欢他上一部作品——但那并不是我们这里要讨论的重点。

这大概算得上是一款能被称作游戏的作品所能达到的最简陋的程度了。这里就是……真的，说实话，什么都没有。如果你已经通过了角色生成器，进入了游戏本身，那你实际上已经见识过这款游戏所能提供的一切了。这里没有真正的故事，没有真正的角色，没有多少……任何东西，真的。你大概会努力弄到你的第一套EVA宇航服，然后意识到这消除了这款游戏里任何一次行动所需的大约一半的工作和预先规划，接着就从那里放弃了。从我在这游戏里只玩了区区5个小时就能看出来，我差不多就是这么做的。

由于开发周期慢得简直像冰川一样，我实在没法推荐它。这游戏是在2020年“发行”的，而我们现在才刚刚获得在游戏内给容器贴标签的能力。好好想想吧：在一款几乎纯粹是关于打捞星际飞船残骸的游戏里，开发者花了超过5年时间才做出一个标签系统。我不知道，我祝他一切顺利。我不后悔把钱扔给这个项目，但你要知道，你现在本质上是在为一款也许大约10年后才能玩的游戏付钱。
